tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
D CORE 100G QSFP to 40G QSFP OM3 AOC Active Optical Cable 5 Meter is a high-speed active optical networking cable designed for connecting compatible 100Gbps QSFP28 ports with 40Gbps QSFP+ network interfaces. It is suitable for data centers, enterprise networks, server connectivity, high-performance computing, and high-bandwidth network infrastructure.


With a 5-meter OM3 multimode optical cable, this AOC provides a convenient solution for short- to medium-distance rack and equipment interconnections while helping maintain reliable high-speed data transmission. AOCs are commonly used for high-bandwidth network links and can simplify installation compared with separate transceiver-and-patch-cable configurations.


Key Features


  • Brand: D CORE
  • Cable Type: Active Optical Cable (AOC)
  • Connector: 100G QSFP28
  • Cable Length: 5 Meter
  • Fiber Type: OM3 Multimode Fiber
  • High-Speed Networking: Supports high-bandwidth data center connectivity
  • Low-Latency Optical Transmission
  • Plug-and-Play Design
  • Suitable for compatible 100G and 40G network equipment
  • Ideal for server-to-switch and switch-to-switch connectivity
